summary.intro: Expanse empowers our students, teachers, and families giving them modern tools and technology to take education to the next level. Expanse boosts engagement, elevates mental health, and teaches purpose through gamification of the educational system.
summary.why: In our world of instant gratification, the rewards of education seem distant and abstract. We are competing with the allure of immediate pleasure, and the dopamine rush of likes and virtual victories. More than half of today's students struggle to find purpose and remain engaged in their education leading to a decline in their overall educational experience. This crisis is reflected in record-low levels of student mental health. The need for change has never been greater.
summary.what: Our software takes intrinsic and extrinsic motivation to the next level allowing students to visualize their growth, build self efficacy, and believe in their ability to succeed. Expanse delivers user-friendly reward systems, reinforces positive behaviors, promotes healthy competition, and builds community through social engagement--powered by integration with Learning Management Systems and Student Information Systems.
summary.who: Expanse enhances the learning experience for all students while actively engaging teachers, schools, districts, family, and the broader community to drive meaningful outcomes.
summary.education: Expanse aims to educate our audiences about engagement, mental health, and learning as a secondary target through content.

primary.description: Students are not engaged in school, and engagement is declining
primary.story: A student completes a group project but feels invisible. No recognition, no progress visible, no reward. They disengage and barely complete the next assignment.
proof: 47% of students are engaged; 53% are not engaged or actively disengaged (2018 Gallup)
Students are 2.5x more likely to get excellent grades when engaged
Students are 4.5x more likely to be hopeful about the future when engaged

primary.description: Students are experiencing record-low levels of mental health
primary.story: A high school junior constantly compares themselves to peers on social media. Each post triggers self-doubt. School offers little positive reinforcement—just grades that never feel good enough.
proof: Mental health crisis among youth is well-documented
Social media comparison drives negative self-image

primary.description: Students don't see the value or purpose in education
primary.story: A middle schooler sits in class wondering, 'Why does this matter?' They've never seen how algebra connects to their dream of becoming a game designer. So they zone out.
proof: Students struggle to connect curriculum to real-world applications
Lack of visible progress toward meaningful goals
Education rewards are too distant and abstract

secondary.description: Constant digital stimulation has reduced ability to focus
Curriculum doesn't connect to student interests or career goals
Teachers lack tools for easy recognition and engagement

items: Planning & Organizing (Researching, Validating, Drafting, Storytelling, Cleaning, MVP Definition)

pitches.name: 30-Second Elevator Pitch
pitches.content: Expanse empowers students, teachers, and families with modern tools to take education to the next level. We boost engagement, elevate mental health, and teach purpose through gamification. In a world of instant gratification where education's rewards seem distant, we bring the dopamine rush to learning.

pitches.name: Problem-Solution Pitch
pitches.content: More than half of today's students struggle to find purpose and remain engaged in their education. This crisis is reflected in record-low levels of student mental health. Expanse solves this by taking intrinsic and extrinsic motivation to the next level—allowing students to visualize their growth, build self-efficacy, and believe in their ability to succeed. Our software delivers user-friendly reward systems, reinforces positive behaviors, promotes healthy competition, and builds community through social engagement, all powered by seamless LMS and SIS integration.

goals.title: Improving Engagement
goals.description: Interest and curiosity through engaging activities that spark student interest and make learning more enjoyable. Positive classroom atmosphere fosters a growth mindset and reduces dropout rates.
subGoals: Enhanced persistence through rewards and hope
Increased intrinsic motivation through growth visualization
Improved focus through quick positive reinforcement
Improved teacher engagement through simple tools

goals.title: Improving Mental Health
goals.description: Success in the classroom boosts students' confidence. Positive feedback and recognition improve mood. Positive reinforcement, recognition of growth, and rewards lead to better school performance.
subGoals: Add more fun through game mechanics

goals.title: Enhanced Academic Performance
goals.description: Direct correlation between engagement, mental health, and academic outcomes.

goals.title: Instilling Growth Mindset
goals.description: Teaching students that abilities can be developed through dedication and hard work.

goals.title: In-Person Socialization
goals.description: Future goal potential—people are not connecting in the same way they used to. The online experience allows control but in-person socialization lacks this barrier-free interaction.

missionConcepts.description: Strategic concepts that drive how Expanse achieves its mission

concepts.name: Double Tapping
concepts.description: Maximize existing student behaviors by gamifying and adding value to actions they already take daily. Instead of forcing new habits, transform what they're already doing (checking grades, completing assignments) into engagement opportunities.
concepts.example: A student checks their grade → see visual growth, earn points, unlock cosmetics

concepts.name: Quicker Gratification
concepts.description: Provide positive emotions and gratification in a shorter amount of time than the alternative. Recognize achievements in the moment to create association between productive behavior and positive emotion.
concepts.principle: Attention spans are declining. Meet users where they are and work toward improvement.

concepts.name: Tangible Rewards
concepts.description: Quantify or gamify actions by providing virtual or real-world rewards for productive academic behaviors.

concepts.name: Visual Growth
concepts.description: Bring purpose to school work by making the results of work immediately visible. Watch your avatar grow and improve as your academics improve.

concepts.name: Easy to Use
concepts.description: Focus on user experience, especially for teachers. Minimize required effort while maximizing reward and engagement value.
concepts.principle: If it requires extra work, adoption fails. Build around existing workflows.

concepts.name: Automation
concepts.description: Automate processes that currently require manual effort. Auto-rewards based on data integration, AI-powered recognition suggestions.

concepts.name: Sense of Progression
concepts.description: Continuous feeling of growth and advancement. Clear path forward with milestones and achievements.

concepts.name: Competition
concepts.description: Healthy competition drives engagement. Leaderboards, class vs class, school vs school challenges.

concepts.name: Collaboration
concepts.description: Team-based goals and social features that build community and shared success.
